description: This file defines the Payment class, a static utility class for managing payment methods within the Goteo application. It includes functions for adding, removing, retrieving, and checking payment methods, as well as handling subscription methods. The class interacts with external payment method classes that implement the PaymentMethodInterface and utilizes configuration and session management components of the application.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: A static class managing payment methods in the Goteo application, allowing registration, deregistration, retrieval, and inspection of payment methods, including support for subscription payment methods.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Registers a new payment method class, optionally forcing registration regardless of configuration.

methods.name: removeMethod
methods.description: Removes a registered payment method by its identifier.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves all registered payment methods, optionally instantiating them for a given user.

methods.name: methodExists
methods.description: Checks if a payment method with the specified identifier is registered.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of the specified payment method, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: defaultMethod
methods.description: Gets or sets the default payment method.

methods.name: getSubscriptionMethods
methods.description: Returns all registered payment methods that are subscription-based.

methods.name: isSubscriptionMethod
methods.description: Checks if a given method identifier corresponds to a subscription payment method.
